usageNotes: Returns all cluster-wide PCI hardware mappings visible to the authenticated user based on Mapping.Modify, Mapping.Use, or Mapping.Audit permissions. Use the optional `check-node` parameter to validate that each mapping's physical devices are present and healthy on a specific node — the response will then include per-mapping diagnostics (warnings or errors). The node named in `check-node` must be online and reachable for diagnostics to populate.

examples.summary: List all PCI mappings and validate them against node pve01

tips: Without `check-node`, the `checks` field is absent from every mapping entry — include it when troubleshooting VM passthrough failures.
PCI mappings are cluster-scoped abstractions; the `map` array entries describe per-node device bindings (node:path pairs), so a single logical mapping can cover multiple physical hosts.
Results are filtered per caller privileges — a restricted API token may see fewer mappings than an admin; audit with a root@pam token to see the full list.
